newsitem.title: FRANCE: French IFOP opinion poll due Sun, more next week.
newsitem.headline: French IFOP opinion poll due Sun, more next week.

text.p: The polling organisation IFOP will publish an opinion poll of voters' intentions for the upcoming French parliamentary election on May 25 and June 1 in the Sunday newspaper Journal du Dimanche, an IFOP official said on Friday.
Officials at Journal du Dimanche were not immediately available for comment.
CSA Institute said on Friday it would not be publishing any new opinion polls of voters' intentions until next week.

An official at CSA said it would be carrying out polls on behalf of television channel France 3, Radio France, French daily Le Parisien and French weekly L'Express. He said no precise dates for any releases had been fixed yet.
Futures traders in Paris said earlier on Friday there was talk CSA and IFOP would be releasing polls later today.

IPSOS, which released a poll late on Thursday in the French weekly Le Point, said it would be publishing a poll each Thursday in Le Point up to the cut off point for releasing poll results which is one week before the first vote on May 25.
SOFRES said on Thursday it was conducting a poll for the French newspaper Le Figaro which would probably appear on Monday.

Louis Harris also said on Thursday it was conducting two polls over the weekend which would appear in the French magazines Valuers Actuelles and Politique Opinion next week, but not before Tuesday, April 29.
